statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir_name=$(basename "$dir"); branch=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && git -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && branch=" ($branch)"; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); inp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0'); out=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0'); mid=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.id'); case "$mid" in *opus*) ic=15.00; oc=75.00;; *sonnet*) ic=3.00; oc=15.00;; *haiku*) ic=0.80; oc=4.00;; *) ic=3.00; oc=15.00;; esac; scost=$(awk -v i="$inp" -v o="$out" -v ic="$ic" -v oc="$oc" 'BEGIN {printf "%.4f", (i/1000000)*ic + (o/1000000)*oc}'); cf="$HOME/.claude/cost_tracking.json"; tcost="0.0000"; ttcost="0.0000"; if [ -f "$cf" ]; then today=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); tcost=$(jq -r --arg d "$today" '.daily[$d] // 0' "$cf" 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0000"); ttcost=$(jq -r '.total // 0' "$cf" 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0000"); fi; ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // 0'); printf "%s%s | %s | \$%s | \$%s | \$%s | %.1f%%" "$dir_name" "$branch" "$model" "$scost" "$tcost" "$ttcost" "$ctx"
